'''Pine nuts''' were a type of [[Nut/Legends|nut]] that could be found on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. At some point, the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]] gathered some pine nuts in a basket. They shared their name with<ref name="Coloring book" /> the [[pine tree]], which could also be found on the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="How">''[[How the Ewoks Saved the Trees: An Old Ewok Legend]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Pine nuts appeared in ''[[Wicket's World Coloring Book]]'', which was published in [[1983]].<ref name="Coloring book" />
